sources.entry: rdkit - Cheminformatics and machine learning software.

summary.one_liner: RDKit is an open-source cheminformatics and machine-learning toolkit with core code in C++ and Python bindings.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes RDKit as a collection of cheminformatics and machine-learning software written in C++ and Python. It provides core data structures and algorithms in C++, with a Python 3 wrapper built using Boost.Python. Java and C# wrappers are generated with SWIG, and JavaScript (via emscripten) and CFFI wrappers expose important functionality. It supports 2D and 3D molecular operations, descriptor and fingerprint generation for machine learning, and a molecular database cartridge for PostgreSQL that handles substructure and similarity searches. It also includes cheminformatics nodes for KNIME and a contrib folder of community-contributed tools.
use_cases: molecular descriptor calculation for machine learning
substructure and similarity search in chemical databases
notable: Core in C++ with Python 3 wrapper generated by Boost.Python
Java and C# wrappers generated with SWIG
PostgreSQL cartridge for substructure and similarity search
Descriptor and fingerprint generation for machine learning
caveats: Detailed installation instructions are in Docs/Book/Install.md rather than the README
README does not describe platform-specific limits beyond the conda recommendation
